title: Statistical Dataset Evaluation: Reliability, Difficulty, and Validity

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Entity Imbalance Degree (EnImBaD) by calculating the standard deviation of the distribution of all different entity types in the dataset to identify underrepresentation of long-tailed instances.
Calculating the Leakage Ratio to measure the proportion of instances in the test set that have already appeared in the training or development sets.
Evaluating annotation correctness (Accuracy) by having professional linguists annotate the proportion of accurately labeled instances to expose mislabeled data.

Measuring data Redundancy (proportion of duplicate instances) and Entity-Null Rate (proportion of instances without any entities) to identify shortcuts or spurious patterns that might artificially inflate model performance.
